regions.region: top title, abstract, and graphical abstract
regions.finding: True paper title/DOI and a generic this-work aminophosphination overview; no concrete experiment-level quantities beyond the overview claim.

regions.region: right column, Scheme 1 arrows (a)-(e) and 'this work'
regions.finding: Five cited prior-literature reaction arrows were classified as literature_example; the final variable allene arrow was classified as a generic_scheme, not as a concrete experiment.

unresolved: Prior-literature arrows use generic R/PG groups and were not expanded into experiments from this paper.
The graphical abstract's '21 examples/up to 93% yields' is a summary claim, not an independently counted reaction.

regions.region: left column optimization narrative and Scheme 2
regions.finding: The model 1a + 2a -> 3a experiment (0.2/0.4 mmol, Tf2O/2,6-lutidine, DCE, N2, room temperature, 2 h, 86%) is the same experiment later repeated in Scheme 3 and the 3a preparation paragraph; it is stored once as record 3a.

regions.region: upper right, Scheme 3 including H2O2 footnote
regions.finding: Generic Scheme 3 plus six product entries: 3a, 3a′, 3b, 3c, 3d, and 3e. The H2O2 footnote is represented as an explicit additional reagent/step for 3a′, with dose/time/temperature left unreported.

Generic Scheme 4 and twelve separate scope entries 5a-5l. 5k is the observed hydroamination product rather than an aminophosphination product. dr >10:1 for 5f/5g and E:Z >10:1 for 5i/5j are crude-NMR selectivity outcomes linked to the respective products.

unresolved: The unenumerated earlier Ag/Cu catalyst/solvent/temperature failures cannot be split into row-level experiments and remain source_context.
Scheme 4 compact substrate drawings do not support fully certain structure transcription for 4h and 4l; their concrete SMILES remain unresolved.
5f/5g source names give (1R,3S), but candidate SMILES do not encode those centers; 5g anti assignment and its X-ray basis are preserved textually.
The exact major/minor identities for both members of each dr result are not fully specified on this page.

regions.finding: anti-5g is attributed to single-crystal X-ray diffraction; E-5i to NOESY. 5h-5l results and the special hydroamination outcome 5k are cross-checked against Scheme 4 rather than counted again.

regions.region: left middle, Scheme 5 and following paragraph
regions.finding: Generic Scheme 5 plus four separate phosphine-oxide scope experiments 6a-6d. Two separately named alternative phosphorus-source trials are qualitative trace controls; exact trace products and measurement method are unreported.
Tentative mechanism A-D was recorded as proposed_mechanism, not as experimental proof or isolated intermediates.

regions.region: lower right, Experimental Section and start of General Procedures
regions.finding: General analytical methods were kept as source_context. The common 0.2 mmol procedure begins here and is inherited only by product paragraphs explicitly saying they were prepared according to it; the sentence continues on page 4.

unresolved: DFT calculation details and full stereochemical evidence are said to be in SI, which was not supplied.
Alternative phosphorus-source control charges, temperature, time, exact product identity, and trace measurement basis are unreported.
The General Procedures sentence continues onto page 4; it was reconstructed only across those two supplied page texts/images.

regions.region: upper left, continuation of General Procedures
regions.finding: Tf2O charge, 2 h room-temperature hold, NaHCO3 quench, CH2Cl2 extraction, Na2SO4 drying, concentration, and short silica column were captured in ordered reaction/workup/purification steps for every explicitly general-procedure scope preparation.
Distinct 5.0 mmol scale-up experiment with all reported masses/volumes/amounts, 2 h at room temperature, 2.1 g product, and 88% isolated yield; not merged with the 0.2 mmol 93% scope preparation.

Product-specific isolated masses, yields, and PE/EtOAc ratios were linked to existing Scheme 3/4 experiment records. NMR/HRMS blocks remain characterization source_context and were not made into reactions.

unresolved: The gram-scale paragraph does not report a chromatography eluent ratio.
Product structures are machine candidates; NMR/HRMS parsing was not used as independent structure verification.
General-procedure inheritance does not fill unreported treatment details for the H2O2-modified 3a′ step.

regions.region: left and right columns, product paragraphs 5c-5j
regions.finding: Each paragraph was associated with its pre-existing Scheme 4 experiment and contributes isolated mass/yield and PE/EtOAc 8:1 purification evidence. Source-labelled (1R,3S) names for 5f/5g and E names for 5i/5j were retained without inventing missing enantiomer/racemate information.
5k is an 87% isolated hydroamination product (57 mg, PE/EtOAc 10:1), with no phosphorus in the product; its characterization continues on page 6 and is not a second reaction.

unresolved: Absolute stereochemical drawings/names for 5f/5g require expert/SI review; their machine SMILES preserve connectivity but not the named centers.
The source reports dr/E:Z measurement basis only in the Scheme 4 footnotes (crude-mixture NMR), not in each product paragraph.
5k HRMS/NMR continuation on page 6 is characterization only.

regions.region: upper left, end of 5k characterization and 5l preparation
regions.finding: The beginning is characterization continuation for 5k, not a new reaction. The 5l paragraph supplies the 90 mg/90% isolated preparation and PE/EtOAc 8:1 purification evidence.

regions.region: left/lower and upper right, 6a-6d product paragraphs
regions.finding: Four Scheme 5 preparations were linked to the existing 6a-6d records with isolated masses/yields and PE/EtOAc 8:1 purification. Their NMR/HRMS data remain characterization context.

regions.region: right column, Associated Content and Accession Codes
regions.finding: The article advertises calculation results, NMR copies, and X-ray data for 5g plus CCDC 2024402. This establishes only that SI exists online, not that an SI file was supplied/associated in this dataset.

unresolved: No SI file was provided; online availability and CCDC accession do not authorize SI association.
Exact stereochemical identity and full atom maps remain machine-review items.
Page 6 characterization data do not independently prove the machine-transcribed structures.
